sentences.en: But for those who don't, South Korean pop, known as K-pop, is a highly stylized art form that has a massive global fan base, giving outsized cultural influence to the small country
sentences.zh: 但对于那些不了解的人来说，韩国流行音乐，即K-pop，是一种高度风格化的艺术形式，拥有庞大的全球粉丝群，为这个小国带来了巨大的文化影响力，

sentences.en: The genre stars, known as idols, are trained, often for years, by entertainment companies.
sentences.zh: 这种流派的明星被称为“偶像”，通常由娱乐公司进行长达数年的培训。

sentences.en: The companies then place the most promising trainees in groups, write and produce their music, and some would say obsessively manage their public image.
sentences.zh: 然后，公司会将最有潜力的练习生组成团体，负责创作和制作他们的音乐，有些人会说，还会极其严苛地管理他们的公众形象。

sentences.en: It's a structure that works for the idols who make it big, but it also draws criticism for its grueling and what some critics call exploitative methods.
sentences.zh: 这种结构对于那些大红大紫的偶像来说是有效的，但也因其艰苦、甚至被一些评论家称为剥削性的手段而受到批评。

sentences.en: One of the biggest stars to come out of that system is Rosé.
sentences.zh: 从这个体系中走出的最大明星之一就是Rosé。

sentences.en: Born Roseanne Park, she trained for years at one of K-pop's largest agencies, YG Entertainment, eventually breaking through as part of the girl group Blackpink.
sentences.zh: 她原名朴彩英（Roseanne Park），在K-pop最大的经纪公司之一YG娱乐公司接受了多年的训练，最终作为女子组合Blackpink的一员脱颖而出。

sentences.en: Now she's striking out on her own with her first full-length solo album called Rosé.
sentences.zh: 现在，她正以名为《Rosé》的首张全长个人专辑开启自己的独立事业。

sentences.en: The lead single, Apathe, is a collaboration with Bruno Mars, and has made history as the first track by a female K-pop artist to break into the top 10 on the Billboard Hot 100.
sentences.zh: 主打单曲《APT.》是与火星哥（Bruno Mars）的合作作品，并作为首位进入公告牌百强单曲榜前十名的女性K-pop艺人作品而载入史册。

sentences.en: So Rosé's star keeps rising.
sentences.zh: 所以，Rosé的星途仍在不断上升。

sentences.en: Still, as she told me, writing her own songs has made her think about where she came from and who she is, apart from the system that made her into a global phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，正如她告诉我的，创作自己的歌曲让她开始思考自己的出身，以及在将她塑造成全球现象的那个体系之外，她究竟是谁。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Rosé.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与Rosé的对话。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: I'm Rosé.
sentences.zh: 我是Rosé。

sentences.en: Hi, Rosé.
sentences.zh: 嗨，Rosé。

sentences.en: Is that how you prefer to be addressed or Rosé?
sentences.zh: 你更喜欢别人这样称呼你，还是叫Rosé？

sentences.en: What would you like?
sentences.zh: 你想要怎么称呼？

sentences.en: You can call me Rosé.
sentences.zh: 你可以叫我Rosé。

sentences.en: Actually, it's just become a habit lately.
sentences.zh: 其实，最近这已经成了习惯。

sentences.en: I usually always introduce myself as Rosé, but you can call me Rosé, Rosé, whatever you feel comfortable with.
sentences.zh: 我通常总是介绍自己为Rosé，但你可以叫我Rosé，Rosé，随你觉得舒服就好。

sentences.en: Is there a difference between the two when you think of yourself as Rosé and when you think of yourself as Rosé?
sentences.zh: 当你把自己想成Rosé时，和你把自己想成Rosé时，这两者之间有什么区别吗？

sentences.en: Um, yes, I think there's a bit of a difference, but it's more like if Rosé was some, you know,
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我觉得有一点区别，但更像是如果Rosé是某个，你知道的，

sentences.en: Rosé was a character that I really worked hard on as a trainee and, you know, it's a part of
sentences.zh: Rosé是我作为练习生时非常努力塑造的一个角色，你知道，它是

sentences.en: Blackpink and I feel like Rosé is whatever is behind that and what came before that.
sentences.zh: Blackpink的一部分，而我觉得Rosé是那个角色背后的东西，以及在那之前存在的东西。

sentences.en: I would say Rosé is the, definitely the character that my friends and family know.
sentences.zh: 我会说Rosé绝对是我朋友和家人所认识的那个角色。

sentences.en: Rosé, you know, is more like, you know, I have music on and I like to be a whole, like
sentences.zh: Rosé，你知道，更像是，你知道，我放着音乐，我喜欢做一个完整的，就像

sentences.en: a diva and like dance, you know, but then Rosé would just be like me at home drowning in my bed.
sentences.zh: 一个天后，喜欢跳舞，你知道，但Rosé可能只是我在家时瘫在床上的样子。

sentences.en: So, this is a huge moment for you.
sentences.zh: 所以，这对你来说是一个巨大的时刻。

sentences.en: You're about to release your first solo album.
sentences.zh: 你即将发行你的第一张个人专辑。

sentences.en: Can you tell me, what are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我，你现在的感受吗？

sentences.en: Um, I feel like I, I've been waiting to release this album for my whole life, I would say.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得我，我这一生都在等待发行这张专辑，我想这么说。

sentences.en: Um,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: just growing up, you know, I grew up listening to a lot of female artists and I used to relate to them a lot and used to, um, really get me through a lot of tough times.
sentences.zh: 成长过程中，你知道，我从小听很多女艺人的歌，我过去常常和她们产生很多共鸣，而且过去常常，嗯，真的帮我度过了很多艰难的时刻。

sentences.en: And so I would always dream of one day having an album myself, but like, I never really thought
sentences.zh: 所以我总是梦想着有一天能拥有自己的专辑，但就像，我从来没觉得

sentences.en: it would be realistic because once I started like being in the industry, I started noticing there's way more that goes into it than I expected.
sentences.zh: 这会是现实，因为一旦我开始进入这个行业，我开始注意到其中涉及的事情比我预期的要多得多。

sentences.en: And I remember last year when I first begun the whole, you know, the process of it, I doubted myself a lot.
sentences.zh: 我记得去年我刚开始整个，你知道，这个过程时，我非常怀疑自己。

sentences.en: Um, and so I feel like it feels really, it feels like a dream that I'm about to release this album, but I kind of lived in this album for the past year, like every single day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以我感觉，发行这张专辑感觉真的像是一个梦，但我过去一年里几乎每天都生活在这张专辑里。

sentences.en: And so I'm ready to be like, okay, get it out now.
sentences.zh: 所以我准备好说，好吧，现在把它发布出来吧。

sentences.en: Time for me to move on as well from that chapter of my life.
sentences.zh: 也是时候让我从人生的那个篇章中走出来了。

sentences.en: You just talked about not having confidence in yourself to do this, which I think probably
sentences.zh: 你刚才谈到对自己没有信心去做这件事，我认为这对于任何看着Rosé的人来说，呃，带着你所有的成功，带着你拥有的庞大粉丝群，嗯，知道你如此怀疑自己，

sentences.en: would be incredibly surprising to anyone who would look at Rosé, uh, with all your success, with the enormous fan base that you have, um, to know that you doubted yourself so much.
sentences.zh: 可能会感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: I was more afraid of, um, cause I don't think I ever learned or trained myself like to be vulnerable and open and honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我更多的是害怕，嗯，因为我不认为我曾经学习或训练过自己去变得脆弱、开放和诚实。

sentences.en: So that was the part I think I feared.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那是我害怕的部分。

sentences.en: Cause it was the opposite of what I was trained to do.
sentences.zh: 因为这与我受训要做的事情恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Um, and I, I really hoped that this album would be exactly that, to be vulnerable and very honest and something that just anyone could relate to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且我，我真的希望这张专辑能做到这一点，变得脆弱、非常诚实，并且是任何人都能产生共鸣的东西。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: And so that was the part I think I feared.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为那是我害怕的部分。

sentences.en: I think that's the perfect opening to talk about how you got to where you are today.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是谈论你如何走到今天这一步的完美开场。

sentences.en: You were born in New Zealand to South Korean immigrant parents.
sentences.zh: 你出生在新西兰，父母是韩国移民。

sentences.en: And then you moved to Australia when you were eight.
sentences.zh: 然后你在八岁时搬到了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: When did you start playing music?
sentences.zh: 你是什么时候开始接触音乐的？

sentences.en: Uh, when I was growing up in Australia, there's really not much to do there.
sentences.zh: 呃，我在澳大利亚长大时，那里真的没什么可做的。

sentences.en: It's not like Soul City or New York.
sentences.zh: 不像首尔或纽约那样。

sentences.en: It's like, it was just school and back home, school and then back home.
sentences.zh: 就像，只是学校和回家，学校然后回家。

sentences.en: And so I'd be really bored.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的很无聊。

sentences.en: And I, my parents had like made me take like piano lessons.
sentences.zh: 而且我，我的父母让我去上钢琴课。

sentences.en: And so I knew how to play a few chords.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道怎么弹几个和弦。

sentences.en: And so I'd like end up just printing chords on paper.
sentences.zh: 所以我最终只是把和弦打印在纸上。

sentences.en: And then I'd like sing along to it.
sentences.zh: 然后我会跟着唱。

sentences.en: Cause it was like form of entertainment basically.
sentences.zh: 因为这基本上是一种娱乐形式。

sentences.en: And then I picked up the guitar because that's when YouTube started blowing up and all these like people would like cover songs.
sentences.zh: 然后我拿起了吉他，因为那是YouTube开始火起来的时候，所有这些像人们一样的人都会翻唱歌曲。

sentences.en: And I'd think that's so cool.
sentences.zh: 我会觉得那太酷了。

sentences.en: Like I want to be that girl who knows how to play the guitar and sings.
sentences.zh: 就像我想成为那个会弹吉他并唱歌的女孩。

sentences.en: And so I like picked up the guitar and I practiced that at home.
sentences.zh: 所以我拿起了吉他，我在家里练习那个。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's, it was really organic.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是，真的很自然。

sentences.en: It was a form of entertainment for me.
sentences.zh: 那对我来说是一种娱乐形式。

sentences.en: So in 2012, when you were 15, you auditioned for a slot in YG Entertainment's trainee program, which is basically sort of a boarding school, if you will, for becoming a K-pop star.
sentences.zh: 所以在2012年，当你15岁时，你参加了YG娱乐公司练习生项目的选拔，这基本上可以算是一所培养K-pop明星的寄宿学校，如果你愿意这么说的话。

sentences.en: It was your dad's idea, right?
sentences.zh: 那是你爸爸的主意，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was it that made your dad want you to audition?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你爸爸想让你去参加选拔？

sentences.en: And did you sort of understand what you were getting into?
sentences.zh: 你当时是否了解你即将进入的是什么样的地方？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So like, that's when like I was watching YouTube a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以就像，那是YouTube火起来的时候。

sentences.en: And if you would search K-pop, there'd be like this whole world in Korea where like, you know, there are trainees and they all train and become K-pop stars.
sentences.zh: 如果你搜索K-pop，在韩国会有这样一个完整的世界，你知道，那里有练习生，他们都在训练并成为K-pop明星。

sentences.en: And so that was kind of like, there was this fantasy about it, obviously.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像，显然对它有一种幻想。

sentences.en: And I think I would sometimes dream and I'd be like, imagine myself actually doing that.
sentences.zh: 我想我有时会做梦，我会想，想象自己真的在做那个。

sentences.en: And I'd be like, oh, that's ridiculous.
sentences.zh: 然后我会想，哦，那太荒谬了。

sentences.en: It never happened.
sentences.zh: 那永远不会发生。

sentences.en: But like, that would be so cool.
sentences.zh: 但那会很酷。

sentences.en: But it wasn't much of a possibility in my head until my dad saw that YG was flying to Australia.
sentences.zh: 但在我爸爸看到YG要飞往澳大利亚之前，这在我的脑海里并不是什么可能性。

sentences.en: And back then, it was very rare that Korean companies would come to all the way to Australia.
sentences.zh: 在当时，韩国公司来到澳大利亚是非常罕见的。

sentences.en: My dad was like, Rosie, like you sing every night till like past midnight and we have to like drag you back into the room.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸说，Rosie，你每天晚上唱歌到午夜过后，我们不得不把你拖回房间。

sentences.en: You obviously like to do this.
sentences.zh: 你显然喜欢做这个。

sentences.en: You should take the audition.
sentences.zh: 你应该去参加选拔。

sentences.en: And I was like, me?
sentences.zh: 我说，我？

sentences.en: I really thought he was joking.
sentences.zh: 我真的以为他在开玩笑。

sentences.en: I'm like, I don't even know how to sing properly.
sentences.zh: 我说，我甚至不知道怎么正确地唱歌。

sentences.en: And he was like, well, you just got to do it.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，你只需要去做就行了。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't work out, then it was a fun experience.
sentences.zh: 如果不行的话，那也是一次有趣的经历。

sentences.en: But you don't want to be like 26 and regret that you never tried it.
sentences.zh: 但你不想到了26岁时后悔自己从未尝试过。

sentences.en: And I was like, oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，好吧。

sentences.en: So we flew to Sydney and I took the audition and I was already like, everyone's so good.
sentences.zh: 所以我们飞到了悉尼，我参加了选拔，我当时已经觉得，每个人都太棒了。

sentences.en: And I remember being like, okay, that was fun.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，好吧，那很有趣。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: But to my surprise, they called us back.
sentences.zh: 但令我惊讶的是，他们叫我们回去。

sentences.en: And then they asked us to pack up our bags and come to Korea in two months.
sentences.zh: 然后他们让我们收拾行李，两个月后去韩国。

sentences.en: And so that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 所以事情就是这样发生的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, becoming a trainee is full time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道，成为一名练习生是全职的。

sentences.en: It's based in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 它位于首尔。

sentences.en: You had to pack up your life and leave in two months.
sentences.zh: 你必须在两个月内收拾好你的生活并离开。

sentences.en: It isn't something it seems that you enter lightly.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不是一件你可以轻易决定的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, what were the conversations like in your family when you were deciding whether to stay or go?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你决定是留下来还是离开时，你们家里的谈话是什么样的？

sentences.en: My mom was very against it at the beginning because obviously she worries about a lot of things, which she should.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈起初非常反对，因为显然她担心很多事情，这是应该的。

sentences.en: And it was like nothing was promised, really.
sentences.zh: 而且就像没有什么是有保证的，真的。

sentences.en: But my dad won.
sentences.zh: 但我爸爸赢了。

sentences.en: And I think I was too young to really think about everything.
sentences.zh: 而且我想我当时太年轻了，没法真正考虑所有事情。

sentences.en: I was more excited.
sentences.zh: 我更多的是感到兴奋。

sentences.en: I didn't even think I knew that I was going to be living in a dorm with the girls.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没想过我知道我要和女孩们住在一个宿舍里。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't understand the fact that I'd be apart from my family.
sentences.zh: 就像，我不明白我将要离开我的家人这一事实。

sentences.en: I just thought I'd be going and, oh, I'm in dorm.
sentences.zh: 我只是以为我要去了，哦，我在宿舍里。

sentences.en: Yay.
sentences.zh: 耶。

sentences.en: And then I remember when I got there, my parents like, OK, we're going now.
sentences.zh: 然后我记得当我到那里时，我的父母说，好了，我们要走了。

sentences.en: We're leaving.
sentences.zh: 我们要离开了。

sentences.en: And I was like, where are you going?
sentences.zh: 我说，你们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: And they're like, we have to go now.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们现在必须走了。

sentences.en: We have to fly back.
sentences.zh: 我们必须飞回去。

sentences.en: And I remember freaking out.
sentences.zh: 我记得我吓坏了。

sentences.en: And that's when it hit me.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我意识到了。

sentences.en: Like, this is very real.
sentences.zh: 就像，这是非常真实的。

sentences.en: I mean, that's crazy, though, to just sort of arrive there and not realize that that's where you're going to be living and staying there.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太疯狂了，只是到达那里，却没有意识到那就是你将要生活和停留的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Did you know much about the Korean idol culture at that point?
sentences.zh: 在那时，你对韩国偶像文化了解多吗？

sentences.en: I did, because that's, again, when YouTube started blowing up and we were like, they were releasing a lot of content in Korea about the trainee life.
sentences.zh: 我了解，因为那又是YouTube开始火起来的时候，我们就像，他们在韩国发布了很多关于练习生生活的内容。

sentences.en: And it was a bit glamorized, sure.
sentences.zh: 而且它确实有点被美化了，当然。

sentences.en: It looked really like everyone was chasing their dreams and working so hard.
sentences.zh: 看起来真的就像每个人都在追逐梦想并努力工作。

sentences.en: And but I think I didn't understand the lonely part of like the loneliness that I would have to go through.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我不了解孤独的那部分，就像我将要经历的孤独。

sentences.en: So that was a bit traumatized, I mean, a bit shocking.
sentences.zh: 所以那有点受创伤，我的意思是，有点令人震惊。

sentences.en: But, you know, I survived it.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我挺过来了。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people outside of Korea don't quite understand how intense the process is to become an idol.
sentences.zh: 我认为韩国以外的很多人并不完全理解成为一名偶像的过程有多么激烈。

sentences.en: What was a typical day like for you?
sentences.zh: 你典型的一天是什么样的？

sentences.en: So for us, the schedule is like we would wake up and I had to wake up at like 930.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，日程安排大概就是我们得起床，我通常得在九点半左右起床。

sentences.en: I remember because I needed to take a shower and then and then we'd be at our dance hall that we all shared between us seven to eight girls.
sentences.zh: 我记得是因为我需要洗个澡，然后我们得去我们七八个女孩共用的练习室。

sentences.en: And we'd have like vocal lessons and dance lessons and language lessons all set up.
sentences.zh: 我们会有声乐课、舞蹈课和语言课，全都安排好了。

sentences.en: And then practice would end at 2 a.m.
sentences.zh: 练习通常在凌晨两点结束。

sentences.en: But if you for me, like I used to want the hall to myself.
sentences.zh: 但如果你问我，我以前总是想独占那个练习室。

sentences.en: So there are many days when you just stay back and use the hall after hours.
sentences.zh: 所以有很多天，你会留下来在下班后继续使用练习室。

sentences.en: And then it just it would repeat like that every single day.
sentences.zh: 然后每一天都是这样重复。

sentences.en: You were clearly very driven to want to make this work.
sentences.zh: 你显然非常有动力，想要把这件事做好。

sentences.en: I think a big part of that was because I had traveled so far for it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得很大一部分原因是因为我为了这个目标走了那么远。

sentences.en: For me, it's if I failed here, then I would have to fly all the way back to Australia.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，如果我在这里失败了，我就得一路飞回澳大利亚。

sentences.en: And all my friends who asked me, where are you going?
sentences.zh: 还有所有问我“你要去哪儿”的朋友们。

sentences.en: I don't understand what you're doing.
sentences.zh: 我不明白你在做什么。

sentences.en: I didn't want to have to explain to them this whole process of me, you know, failing and flying back.
sentences.zh: 我不想向他们解释我经历的整个过程，你知道，就是失败然后飞回去。

sentences.en: I mean, it says something about you that you had so much discipline and so much drive that you wanted to sort of get to a place.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你拥有如此强的自律和动力，想要达到某个目标，这本身就说明了你的不凡。

sentences.en: I think I learned that about myself when I got to YG.
sentences.zh: 我想我是在进入YG之后才了解到自己这一点的。

sentences.en: It wasn't something that I had before and that got me there.
sentences.zh: 这不是我之前就有的特质，也不是我能进入那里的原因。

sentences.en: It was more like I got there and then I was put in that situation.
sentences.zh: 更像是当我到了那里，被置于那种环境中。

sentences.en: And that's when I learned so much about myself.
sentences.zh: 那时我才对自己有了很多了解。

sentences.en: And I'm very, yeah, very like determined.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实，是的，非常坚定。

sentences.en: And that's when I learned, I was like, oh, this is the type of person I am.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我意识到，哦，原来我是这样的人。

sentences.en: I read you'd get only one day off every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 我读到过你们每两周才有一天假。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What did you do on your day off?
sentences.zh: 你休息日都做什么？

sentences.en: Lisa is from Thailand as well.
sentences.zh: Lisa也是泰国人。

sentences.en: So Lisa and I didn't have friends or family there.
sentences.zh: 所以Lisa和我当时在那里都没有朋友或家人。

sentences.en: So we would...
sentences.zh: 所以我们就会……

sentences.en: Another member of Blackpink?
sentences.zh: Blackpink的另一位成员？

sentences.en: Yes, another member of Blackpink.
sentences.zh: 是的，Blackpink的另一位成员。

sentences.en: We were in the same room.
sentences.zh: 我们住同一个房间。

sentences.en: And so we'd wake up and I'd be like, I'm going to church.
sentences.zh: 所以我们醒来后，我会说，我要去教堂。

sentences.en: And so I'd meet her after church.
sentences.zh: 然后我会在礼拜结束后见到她。

sentences.en: And then we'd go shopping and go to our favorite stores.
sentences.zh: 接着我们会去逛街，去我们最喜欢的店。

sentences.en: Remember this place called Myeongdong back then.
sentences.zh: 记得当时有个地方叫明洞。

sentences.en: We don't go there anymore, but we'd go to Myeongdong and like go shopping.
sentences.zh: 我们现在不去那里了，但那时我们会去明洞逛街。

sentences.en: And then I remember we'd always pass like...
sentences.zh: 我记得我们总是会经过……

sentences.en: Jordan's was like a big thing.
sentences.zh: 乔丹鞋当时很火。

sentences.en: The sneakers, Nike Jordan, I remember.
sentences.zh: 耐克乔丹运动鞋，我记得。

sentences.en: And like, it was like such a big hype back then, but it was so expensive.
sentences.zh: 那在当时真的很流行，但太贵了。

sentences.en: So we'd always go to the store and like look at all the shoes and be like, oh, it's so pretty.
sentences.zh: 所以我们总是去店里看那些鞋，然后说，哦，太漂亮了。

sentences.en: Like, this is so expensive.
sentences.zh: 但这太贵了。

sentences.en: I really want these.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想要这些。

sentences.en: And we wouldn't be able to buy it.
sentences.zh: 但我们买不起。

sentences.en: So I feel like maybe next time.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得也许下次吧。

sentences.en: And we'd actually go shopping for the things that we had to wear for training.
sentences.zh: 我们其实会去买那些训练时需要穿的东西。

sentences.en: For like for training, we'd have to do these like weekly and like monthly tests.
sentences.zh: 因为训练时，我们得参加每周和每月的测试。

sentences.en: And so for that, we need to look good.
sentences.zh: 所以为了测试，我们需要看起来状态很好。

sentences.en: And so we'd have to style ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们得自己搭配造型。

sentences.en: But like, you know, we didn't know much about clothes.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，我们对服装了解不多。

sentences.en: And, you know, with the money that my parents would send us, we'd like go out and like try to look good.
sentences.zh: 而且，用父母寄给我们的钱，我们会出去尝试打扮得好看些。

sentences.en: And so it was like a constant, you know, battle of proving to the company that this is who we are.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像是一场持续的战斗，向公司证明这就是我们。

sentences.en: This is the artist that I can be.
sentences.zh: 这就是我可以成为的艺人。

sentences.en: This is the artist I am.
sentences.zh: 这就是我作为艺人的样子。

sentences.en: And to be an artist is like fashion is a big part of it and how we present ourselves as an artiSt.
sentences.zh: 成为一名艺人，时尚是其中很重要的一部分，以及我们如何以艺人的身份展示自己。

sentences.en: And so like we worked really hard on that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这方面真的很努力。

sentences.en: The idea here is that they're training you to be this huge star.
sentences.zh: 这里的想法是，他们正在把你训练成一颗巨星。

sentences.en: So in addition to singing and dancing, did you get instruction on like the public facing aspects of the job?
sentences.zh: 那么除了唱歌跳舞，你是否接受过关于这份工作面向公众方面的指导？

sentences.en: Did they try to prepare you for what fame might be like?
sentences.zh: 他们有没有试着让你为成名后的生活做好准备？

sentences.en: No, not necessarily.
sentences.zh: 不，不一定。

sentences.en: I personally think that especially us four, like Blackpink, we're very, we're all smart enough to be, to navigate our way through and we're all very responsible.
sentences.zh: 我个人认为，尤其是我们四个，也就是Blackpink，我们都足够聪明，能够驾驭自己的道路，而且我们都非常有责任感。

sentences.en: And so I'm guessing that's why, you know, we got selected.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜这就是为什么我们被选中了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I just believe that.
sentences.zh: 我只是相信这一点。

sentences.en: But yeah, it's not like they like told us anything specific, like this is what you're going to be going through mentally, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 但确实，他们并没有告诉我们什么具体的，比如你在心理上会经历什么之类的。

sentences.en: It was like, yeah, it was more organic than that.
sentences.zh: 这更像是自然而然发生的。

sentences.en: I think if that was all taught as well, it seems a bit weird.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果这些都被教导出来，反而显得有点奇怪。

sentences.en: It seems very, like very planned.
sentences.zh: 看起来会非常刻意。

sentences.en: But we were there for music.
sentences.zh: 但我们是为了音乐才在那里的。

sentences.en: And so we just worked on music.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只是专注于音乐。

sentences.en: Well, you were at the academy for four years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你在学院待了四年。

sentences.en: Some of the people who train there trained for six or seven years.
sentences.zh: 有些在那里训练的人训练了六七年。

sentences.en: Does it seem like a good system?
sentences.zh: 这看起来是一个好的体系吗？

sentences.en: Well, me personally, I still talk about it sometimes.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就我个人而言，我有时还会谈论它。

sentences.en: And I say, I'm like talking to my producer and I say, I really miss the days where I was given all the time in the world to work on my music.
sentences.zh: 我会和我的制作人说，我真的很怀念那些拥有全世界的时间来创作音乐的日子。

sentences.en: And I said, at the time, it was like endless hours.
sentences.zh: 我说，当时感觉有无尽的时间。

sentences.en: And sometimes I was hopeful.
sentences.zh: 有时我充满希望。

sentences.en: Sometimes it felt like, felt hopeless.
sentences.zh: 有时又感到绝望。

sentences.en: But I think deep down inside, I really enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为在内心深处，我真的很享受那段时光。

sentences.en: Being able to live in that with all the time.
sentences.zh: 能够沉浸在那种拥有所有时间的状态里。

sentences.en: Like, I think that was like a really special moment that I'm never probably going to be able to get back to just solely do that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是一个非常特别的时刻，我可能再也回不去了，无法再那样纯粹地做音乐。

sentences.en: And I tell, I say, I'm like, when I look at trainees and the girls that are like coming up, I really think, I'm like, I envy that kind of.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们，当我看到练习生和那些正在成长中的女孩时，我真的很羡慕那种状态。

sentences.en: Because even though it was mentally challenging, I think the trainee days of me pushing through all those hardships has, you know, helped me, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管那在心理上很有挑战性，但我认为我克服所有困难的练习生岁月，你知道，帮助了我，

sentences.en: do these things for myself even to this day.
sentences.zh: 即使在今天也能为自己做这些事情。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it sounds like a lot to navigate.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这听起来需要应对的事情很多。

sentences.en: What was it like when all of a sudden Blackpink comes out and it just becomes an immediate success?
sentences.zh: 当Blackpink突然出道并立即取得成功时，那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: What was the transition like from being a trainee with all the time in the world to do your music to suddenly becoming an actual pop star?
sentences.zh: 从一个拥有全世界时间做音乐的练习生，突然变成一个真正的流行明星，这种转变是什么样的？

sentences.en: I think that might have been the hard, maybe the hardest part for me, because I think being a trainee, yes, settling into this whole new world with people you don't know,
sentences.zh: 我觉得那可能是我最困难的部分，因为我认为作为练习生，是的，要适应这个你完全不认识的人组成的新世界，

sentences.en: that is challenging.
sentences.zh: 那确实很有挑战性。

sentences.en: But it was still off camera and I got to make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 但那还是在镜头之外，我可以犯错。

sentences.en: Yes,
sentences.zh: 是的，

sentences.en: but I feel like the transition of now having to be on camera and being an artist and presenting to the world who I am, that's something we just had to learn as we went.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉现在必须面对镜头，成为一名艺人，并向世界展示我是谁，这种转变是我们必须在过程中学习的。

sentences.en: So I think the first few years was very difficult for me personally.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为最初的几年对我个人来说非常困难。

sentences.en: But, you know, a few years in, I started picking it up and learning.
sentences.zh: 但是，几年后，我开始上手并学会了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: What was hard about it?
sentences.zh: 难点在哪里？

sentences.en: I think it's still hard, actually, and it kind of never stopped since then.
sentences.zh: 我觉得其实现在依然很难，而且从那时起就从未停止过。

sentences.en: I mean, what I'm hearing is that you had to find out who you were in the glare of this very big spotlight.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我听到的是，你必须在巨大的聚光灯下寻找真实的自我。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of the things that is unique about K-pop is that the fan culture is so specific and so enormous.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，K-pop独特的一点是粉丝文化非常具体且庞大。

sentences.en: Can you tell me a little bit about that relationship?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我聊聊那种关系吗？

sentences.en: I mean, how authentic did you feel like you could be?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你觉得你能表现得有多真实？

sentences.en: How authentic did you want to be?
sentences.zh: 你想表现得有多真实？

sentences.en: I mean, I felt like we were trained to always present ourselves in the most perfect, like, perfect way.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得我们受训时总是要以最完美的方式展示自己。

sentences.en: And so even when we were, like, interacting with them online, it was when I was ready to give perfect answers and give people what they wanted.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是在网上与他们互动时，也是在我准备好给出完美答案、满足人们需求的时候。

sentences.en: And making sure that I'm interested in making sure that I'm a perfect girl for everyone.
sentences.zh: 并确保我感兴趣的是成为每个人心目中完美的女孩。

sentences.en: And so I think that's kind of, that was the culture.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这就是那种文化。

sentences.en: And then that's why leading into this album, it was a little bit of a, it is more personal want and need to be able to write an album that I grew up, like,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在制作这张专辑时，我有一种更个人的愿望和需求，想要写一张我成长过程中听过的、我觉得能产生共鸣的音乐专辑。

sentences.en: I had listened to music that I felt like I could relate to.
sentences.zh: 我听过那些让我觉得能产生共鸣的音乐。

sentences.en: But in order for that, I'm sure, like, artists had to be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 但为了做到这一点，我肯定，艺人必须展现脆弱的一面。

sentences.en: But, you know, we hadn't trained to talk about our emotions and feelings and experiences.
sentences.zh: 但是，我们并没有受过谈论情绪、感受和经历的训练。

sentences.en: So it must have been scary.
sentences.zh: 所以那一定很可怕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To do this, because this is a very personal album.
sentences.zh: 做这件事，因为这是一张非常私人的专辑。

sentences.en: Let's talk about Rosie.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈Rosie。

sentences.en: When you had to sit down with yourself and write this album, what was that like to have to dig deep?
sentences.zh: 当你必须静下心来写这张专辑时，那种深入挖掘内心的感觉是什么样的？

sentences.en: To be honest, like, doing it, it was, that was like breathing.
sentences.zh: 老实说，做这件事就像呼吸一样自然。

sentences.en: All the stories in there are stories that, you know, anyone around me has heard more than 20 times.
sentences.zh: 里面的所有故事都是我身边的人听过超过20遍的故事。

sentences.en: It was about time I wrote it in a song.
sentences.zh: 是时候把它们写进歌里了。

sentences.en: But it was like, I had moments where I was like, wait, can we say this?
sentences.zh: 但确实有过这样的时刻，我会想，等等，我们可以说这个吗？

sentences.en: Wait, maybe we shouldn't put that word in there.
sentences.zh: 等等，也许我们不该把那个词放进去。

sentences.en: Maybe this is too much.
sentences.zh: 也许这太过了。

sentences.en: Should we not?
sentences.zh: 我们不该这样做吗？

sentences.en: And then I think it was like the process of me letting that go.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得这是一个让我放下这些顾虑的过程。

sentences.en: What's the fear, though, when you're saying, I don't want to put that in there?
sentences.zh: 当你对自己说“我不想放进去”时，恐惧到底是什么？

sentences.en: Like, I guess at first, like, I mean, I'm talking, I'm talking about very normal experiences.
sentences.zh: 我想起初，我是说，我谈论的是非常正常的经历。

sentences.en: That normal 20, like, you're all in their 20s is going through.
sentences.zh: 那是所有20多岁的人都会经历的正常事情。

sentences.en: And so, like I said, there's a whole world and a whole life behind, you know, screen where I experience things that my fans hasn't really heard about or seen and talked about.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像我说的，在屏幕背后有一个完整的世界和生活，我经历过粉丝们并没有真正听说过、看到过或谈论过的事情。

sentences.en: And so, like, sometimes it does scare me.
sentences.zh: 所以，有时这确实让我感到害怕。

sentences.en: It's like, yeah, can I show this side of me?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我可以展示这一面的我吗？

sentences.en: And am I allowed to talk about this?
sentences.zh: 我被允许谈论这个吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's not even like crazy things, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 老实说，甚至都不是什么疯狂的事情。

sentences.en: It's a very normal thing.
sentences.zh: 是非常正常的事情。

sentences.en: So it sounds like I'm going to be talking about some crazy experiences.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来好像我要谈论一些疯狂的经历。

sentences.en: It's not really that crazy.
sentences.zh: 其实并没有那么疯狂。

sentences.en: It's very normal things.
sentences.zh: 都是非常正常的事情。

sentences.en: No, the themes are heartache, lost love, anger sometimes at people.
sentences.zh: 不，主题是心碎、失去的爱，有时是对人的愤怒。

sentences.en: I mean, the range of human emotions.
sentences.zh: 我是说，人类情感的范围。

sentences.en: Yeah, romance.
sentences.zh: 是的，浪漫。

sentences.en: But even that is, like, it's scary for me.
sentences.zh: 但即使是那样，对我来说也很可怕。

sentences.en: So that was, yeah, it was like I could see, like, the faces in the producers and songwriters, they were like, so interesting, Rosie.
sentences.zh: 所以当时，我能看到制作人和词曲作者脸上的表情，他们觉得，太有趣了，Rosie。

sentences.en: Why are you so nervous about this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么对此这么紧张？

sentences.en: And I'm like, you guys, you don't know.
sentences.zh: 我说，你们不懂。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, I've seen reporting that, you know, K-pop agencies have strict rules when it comes to dating.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，我看到过报道说，K-pop经纪公司在约会方面有严格的规定。

sentences.en: And in part, maybe because they want fans to feel like idols are in a relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 部分原因可能是他们希望粉丝觉得偶像是在和他们谈恋爱。

sentences.en: Is that part of the fear that it's not normal for stars to necessarily share that?
sentences.zh: 这种恐惧是否部分源于明星分享这些并不正常？

sentences.en: Well, yeah, it was not normal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，这确实不正常。

sentences.en: It isn't normal.
sentences.zh: 这并不正常。

sentences.en: But also, it's just not normal for me, too.
sentences.zh: 但同时，对我来说这也不正常。

sentences.en: Like, I had never really spoken about it.
sentences.zh: 因为我从未真正谈论过它。

sentences.en: Because I feel like there's no need for me to ever confirm anything or talk about it.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得我没有必要去确认任何事情或谈论它。

sentences.en: But I think that's why, like, this album means a lot to me.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这就是为什么这张专辑对我意义重大。

sentences.en: Because it's just like, these things are just inspirations for my art.
sentences.zh: 因为这些经历只是我艺术创作的灵感来源。

sentences.en: So I do want to make sure that that's, like, very well addressed.
sentences.zh: 所以我确实想确保这一点能得到很好的阐述。

sentences.en: The fact that it's not about the story of who Rosie has been with or whatever.
sentences.zh: 重点不在于Rosie和谁在一起过之类的故事。

sentences.en: It's really more about the art.
sentences.zh: 重点其实更多是在艺术本身。

sentences.en: And it's scary.
sentences.zh: 这很可怕。

sentences.en: It's kind of unfair that I have to think about that part of it.
sentences.zh: 我不得不去考虑那一部分，这其实有点不公平。

sentences.en: Because really, again, it's just an element of inspiration.
sentences.zh: 因为再说一次，这真的只是灵感的一个元素。

sentences.en: I can hear you drawing a boundary.
sentences.zh: 我听得出你在划清界限。

sentences.en: You know, that your personal life is your personal life, which I totally respect.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你的私生活就是你的私生活，我完全尊重这一点。

sentences.en: I was really struck by one particular song off the album, which is called Number One Girl.
sentences.zh: 专辑里有一首歌让我印象深刻，叫《Number One Girl》。

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的。

sentences.en: When I listened, it felt like it could be about a romantic relationship or about a relationship with fame and celebrity.
sentences.zh: 当我听的时候，感觉它既可以是指一段浪漫关系，也可以是指与名气和偶像身份的关系。

sentences.en: One of the lyrics goes, tell me I'm that new thing.
sentences.zh: 其中一句歌词是：告诉我我是那个新宠。

sentences.en: Tell me that I'm relevant.
sentences.zh: 告诉我我还很有热度。

sentences.en: Can you talk to me a little bit about that song?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我聊聊这首歌吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, that song was written after a terrible night of scrolling through the internet till, like, 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那首歌是在一个糟糕的夜晚写的，当时我刷手机刷到了凌晨6点。

sentences.en: And I barely got any sleep.
sentences.zh: 我几乎没怎么睡。

sentences.en: I rocked up to the studio the next day, very cranky.
sentences.zh: 第二天我脾气很暴躁地去了录音室。

sentences.en: And they asked me, how have you been?
sentences.zh: 他们问我：你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: And I was like, very bad.
sentences.zh: 我说：非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I'm so exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我精疲力竭。

sentences.en: I'm exhausted trying to please everyone.
sentences.zh: 我为了取悦所有人而感到精疲力竭。

sentences.en: I'm always just trying my best to be my best version, but I felt a little lost and felt like I was never good enough.
sentences.zh: 我总是尽我所能去展现最好的自己，但我感到有点迷茫，觉得无论怎么做都不够好。

sentences.en: And I was a bit cranky, cranky against the world and just the universe.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点烦躁，对世界和宇宙都感到烦躁。

sentences.en: And I was like, you know, I want to write a song that's just so disgustingly open and honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我要写一首歌，要写得极其坦诚、毫无保留。

sentences.en: Like, you know, things that I hate myself for, like thinking.
sentences.zh: 比如，那些连我自己都因为产生过这种想法而讨厌自己的念头。

sentences.en: I said, like, all those thoughts that's written in those lyrics are thoughts that I don't want to admit that I actually think.
sentences.zh: 我说，歌词里写的那些想法，都是我平时不想承认自己会有过的念头。

sentences.en: Because I think I like to present myself as a very positive girl who's like, who just, who doesn't think about negative things, who's very just bright-minded and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得我喜欢把自己塑造成一个非常积极的女孩，一个不考虑负面事物、思想开朗的人等等。

sentences.en: But I think that was honestly the day.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，那天就是这样。

sentences.en: I was like, nope, I have these days.
sentences.zh: 我当时想：不，我也有这样的时候。

sentences.en: What were you watching online?
sentences.zh: 你在网上看什么呢？

sentences.en: What were you seeing?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: I was looking at comments, you know, like just searching topics that were not going to necessarily satisfy me.
sentences.zh: 我在看评论，你知道的，就是去搜索那些未必会让我开心的内容。

sentences.en: And I just like go down like rabbit holes of negative comments and just, I don't think I knew, I didn't understand what I was searching for as well.
sentences.zh: 我陷入了负面评论的深渊，而且我觉得我当时甚至不明白自己在搜什么。

sentences.en: But I was looking for validation and, and I felt like, wow, it was a lonely world that night and that on, on the internet, on social media, it was a lonely world.
sentences.zh: 但我是在寻求认同感，那天晚上我感到这是一个孤独的世界，在互联网上，在社交媒体上，那是一个孤独的世界。

sentences.en: And, and as I was writing the song, I felt there must be so many other girls who experienced this.
sentences.zh: 当我写这首歌的时候，我觉得一定还有很多女孩经历过这些。

sentences.en: And, and so I just want people to know that I'm, I'm no different.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想让大家知道，我和她们没什么不同。

sentences.en: What does vampire Holly mean?
sentences.zh: “吸血鬼Holly”是什么意思？

sentences.en: Because you've, vampire Holly was another day of those.
sentences.zh: 因为你……“吸血鬼Holly”也是那样的日子里的产物。

sentences.en: Because you, it's your new handle on Instagram and one of the songs on the album.
sentences.zh: 因为那是你在Instagram上的新账号，也是专辑里的一首歌。

sentences.en: And I can't let you break me like this is one of the lines.
sentences.zh: “我不能让你这样摧毁我”是其中的一句歌词。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Tell me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那个吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Vampire Holly was my private Instagram account.
sentences.zh: “吸血鬼Holly”是我的私人Instagram账号。

sentences.en: It was just an account that I made so that I didn't have to be like, because my official account is like, has a lot of followers.
sentences.zh: 我开这个账号只是为了不用顾忌那么多，因为我的官方账号有很多粉丝。

sentences.en: And I always have to think about what people are going to think of me.
sentences.zh: 我总是不得不考虑别人会怎么看我。

sentences.en: But I wanted an Instagram where I just felt, just didn't have to be cool.
sentences.zh: 但我想要一个Instagram账号，在那里我感觉自己不需要表现得那么酷。

sentences.en: It's your finsta.
sentences.zh: 那是你的小号（finsta）。

sentences.en: It's my finsta.
sentences.zh: 那是我的小号。

sentences.en: And it's what I just used.
sentences.zh: 我就是这么用的。

sentences.en: And then I remember, you know, a few fans found out about the Instagram and then I think they started getting, they, they would, you know, there are certain people who,
sentences.zh: 后来我记得，有些粉丝发现了这个账号，然后我觉得他们开始……有些人想要恶意中伤，他们试图想尽一切办法来针对我。

sentences.en: who want to be negative and they, they were trying to find all the ways to get to me.
sentences.zh: 他们试图想尽一切办法来针对我。

sentences.en: And I guess they ended up getting to that account and then using that to like cause drama and, and create, actually trigger me.
sentences.zh: 我想他们最终找到了那个账号，并利用它来制造事端，甚至故意激怒我。

sentences.en: And I, they were, it felt like obviously they were obsessed with the thought of like controlling me and, you know, that, but then I felt like I was obsessed back.
sentences.zh: 他们显然沉迷于控制我的想法，你知道，但后来我觉得我也反过来沉迷于关注他们了。

sentences.en: But then I remember after I wrote that, I let it all go and I never went back to it again.
sentences.zh: 但写完那首歌后，我记得我彻底放下了，再也没有回去看过。

sentences.en: There is a big anti-fan movement in K-pop where there's a lot of bullying online, especially of female artists.
sentences.zh: 在K-pop圈里有一个很大的反黑粉运动，网上有很多霸凌现象，尤其是针对女性艺人。

sentences.en: And it sounds like this was part of that.
sentences.zh: 听起来这也是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: You were experiencing that.
sentences.zh: 你当时正在经历这些。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是吧。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't want to get emotional about it.
sentences.zh: 我不想谈起这个就情绪激动。

sentences.en: But.
sentences.zh: 但是。

sentences.en: It's okay.
sentences.zh: 没关系。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I think like, um, I didn't think that, cause I would say I'm pretty strong minded as well.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，嗯，我没想过会这样，因为我会说我自己的心理素质也挺强的。

sentences.en: I'm pretty like, I'm not that, like I'm very positive as well.
sentences.zh: 我挺……我也非常积极。

sentences.en: And I like to be smart about, you know, how things affect me.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢理智地看待事物对我的影响。

sentences.en: But I think I remember when it felt like it actually did get to me that like, it felt pretty, pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 但我记得当它真的影响到我的时候，感觉真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: I was like, oh my gosh, I am going through this.
sentences.zh: 我当时想：天哪，我竟然在经历这些。

sentences.en: I never, I never thought I would.
sentences.zh: 我从没想过我会这样。

sentences.en: I think I would see things online and I'd always think it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 我以前在网上看到这些事时，总觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: You're just like, I wonder why they let that get to them, you know?
sentences.zh: 你会想：不知道为什么他们会让这些影响到自己，对吧？

sentences.en: But I remember when it did, I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 但当它真的发生在我身上时，我震惊了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry that that happened to you.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉你经历了这些。

sentences.en: And I know you've talked about your own mental health and how demanding it can feel to protect yourself from this stuff.
sentences.zh: 我知道你谈过自己的心理健康，也谈过保护自己免受这些伤害是多么吃力。

sentences.en: What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做的？

sentences.en: Um, well, in this case, now that I've found a songwriting, we'll write it in a song.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在这种情况下，既然我找到了写歌这条路，那我们就把它写进歌里。

sentences.en: If life gives you lemons, you make lemonade.
sentences.zh: 如果生活给你柠檬，你就把它做成柠檬水。

sentences.en: I think that was the only thing.
sentences.zh: 我想这是唯一的办法。

sentences.en: It was kind of surprising because songwriting came to me as like a blessing at the moment I really needed it.
sentences.zh: 这有点令人惊讶，因为写歌在我最需要的时候像是一种恩赐降临到我身上。

sentences.en: And I was like, wow, I would walk in with a big problem.
sentences.zh: 我当时想：哇，我带着巨大的问题走进去。

sentences.en: I'd store it in a song and it would leave my mind.
sentences.zh: 我把它存进歌里，它就离开了我的大脑。

sentences.en: It'd leave my heart.
sentences.zh: 它离开了我的内心。

sentences.en: And so as cheesy as it sounds, that's the songwriting has helped me.
sentences.zh: 所以尽管听起来很老套，但写歌确实帮了我。

sentences.en: Like it actually like leaves my soul as I leave it in a song.
sentences.zh: 就像我把它写进歌里，它就真的从我的灵魂中剥离了。

sentences.en: But then there are some days where I don't like the song and I'm like, that didn't help.
sentences.zh: 但也有一些日子我不喜欢那首歌，我会想：那没用。

sentences.en: That didn't help.
sentences.zh: 那没用。

sentences.en: That song's not going to be in the album.
sentences.zh: 那首歌不会被收录进专辑里。

sentences.en: I'm still suffering now.
sentences.zh: 我现在还在受苦。

sentences.en: So we better write.
sentences.zh: 所以我们最好继续写。

sentences.en: It's kind of, it was actually like that.
sentences.zh: 其实就是这样。

sentences.en: I think I ended up, I was so addicted to songwriting at one point because I'd have these concepts that I wanted to write about.
sentences.zh: 我想我最后甚至对写歌上瘾了，因为我有想要表达的概念。

sentences.en: And then we'd paint it, but it wouldn't be the right image.
sentences.zh: 然后我们把它描绘出来，但画面不对。

sentences.en: And I'd be like, no, like, yeah, but that's not what I wanted to say.
sentences.zh: 我会说：不，虽然是这样，但那不是我想表达的。

sentences.en: I, okay, scratch that again, again, again.
sentences.zh: 好吧，重来，再来，再来。

sentences.en: And then I'd get the song and I'd be like, yes.
sentences.zh: 然后我得到了那首歌，我会说：对了。

sentences.en: And I'd actually heal from it.
sentences.zh: 我真的从中得到了治愈。

sentences.en: And I would never actually think about it again because it literally just lives in that song.
sentences.zh: 我再也不会去想它了，因为它真的就只活在那首歌里。

sentences.en: And it actually heals me.
sentences.zh: 它真的治愈了我。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: After the break, I call Rosé back.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，我将再次连线Rosé。

sentences.en: And she tells me about what's next for Blackpink as its four members pursue their solo careers.
sentences.zh: 她会告诉我Blackpink在四位成员各自追求个人事业后的下一步计划。

sentences.en: I think we all have obviously love for Blackpink.
sentences.zh: 我想我们显然都热爱Blackpink。

sentences.en: But I think we were, I would say, mature enough to come to a conclusion that in order for us to continue this in a healthy way,
sentences.zh: 但我想我们已经足够成熟，能够得出一个结论：为了让我们以健康的方式继续下去，

sentences.en: we also have to acknowledge that we all have also individual needs and wants.
sentences.zh: 我们也必须承认，我们每个人也都有个人的需求和愿望。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是Wena Liu。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的《Connections》谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是Sam Azersky，我每天负责制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Thanks for talking to me again.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你再次接受我的采访。

sentences.en: I want to start by asking you about the idea of the seven-year curse in K-pop, which refers to the trend of groups disbanding around their seventh year together.
sentences.zh: 我想先问问你关于K-pop中“七年魔咒”的看法，这指的是组合在成团七年左右解散的趋势。

sentences.en: And that kind of coincides sometimes with record contracts expiring.
sentences.zh: 这有时也恰好与唱片合约到期的时间重合。

sentences.en: But Blackpink just resigned with YG Entertainment in 2023.
sentences.zh: 但Blackpink在2023年与YG娱乐续约了。

sentences.en: So, you know, you have all gone off and had solo projects.
sentences.zh: 所以，你们都各自开始了个人项目。

sentences.en: Did you ever think about breaking up when you were going off to explore what the solo experience was going to be?
sentences.zh: 在你们去探索个人发展时，有没有想过要解散？

sentences.en: It was definitely a moment of all of us sitting down and thinking about what we wanted individually, all four of us.
sentences.zh: 那绝对是我们四个人坐下来思考我们各自想要什么的时刻。

sentences.en: Because, you know, it's a group of four, like, we all have to make decisions on behalf of, like, what we really, truly wanted.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个四人组合，我们都必须代表我们真正想要的东西来做决定。

sentences.en: And so it wasn't, like, a quick decision.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个仓促的决定。

sentences.en: I think it was over a course of, like, a few months.
sentences.zh: 我想这花了几个月的时间。

sentences.en: Like, we kind of started thinking about it in advance.
sentences.zh: 我们提前就开始考虑这件事了。

sentences.en: I think as we all, like, you know, we communicated a lot.
sentences.zh: 我想我们沟通了很多。

sentences.en: And we decided we, I think we all have, obviously, love for Blackpink and performing as Blackpink.
sentences.zh: 我们决定……我想我们显然都热爱Blackpink，也热爱以Blackpink的名义表演。

sentences.en: But I think we were, I would say, mature enough to come to a conclusion that in order for us to continue this in a healthy way and maintain that passion,
sentences.zh: 但我想我们已经足够成熟，能够得出一个结论：为了让我们以健康的方式继续下去，并保持那份热情，

sentences.en: in the long run, we also have to acknowledge that we all have also individual needs and wants.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，我们也必须承认，我们每个人也都有个人的需求和愿望。

sentences.en: And so we came to a healthy conclusion of, you know, making sure we all kind of got to do what we wanted to do for a good period of time and then get together.
sentences.zh: 所以我们达成了一个健康的共识，确保我们每个人都能在一段时间内做自己想做的事，然后再聚在一起。

sentences.en: So that's what's happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Next year would be Blackpink's, we would probably be releasing music and we're set for Tua.
sentences.zh: 明年Blackpink可能会发布新音乐，我们已经准备好巡演了。

sentences.en: I do want to ask you another thing about the trainee system.
sentences.zh: 我还想问你关于练习生制度的另一件事。

sentences.en: Because I heard you say that for you, your time as a trainee was basically pretty positive.
sentences.zh: 因为我听说你提到对你来说，练习生的时光基本上是相当积极的。

sentences.en: You described it as a period where you really dedicated all your time to doing the thing that you loved.
sentences.zh: 你把它描述为一段你真正全身心投入到自己热爱的事情上的时期。

sentences.en: But, you know, I've read a lot about how the system has been criticized in the culture and also legally as being exploitative financially, maybe even emotionally.
sentences.zh: 但是，我读过很多关于这个制度在文化上甚至法律上被批评为在经济上、甚至情感上存在剥削的报道。

sentences.en: There have been allegations of abuse.
sentences.zh: 还有关于虐待的指控。

sentences.en: And so I guess I was wondering, do you think that the system overall is a good way to help nurture young art and artists?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，你认为这个制度总体上是培养年轻艺术和艺人的好方法吗？

sentences.en: I personally, because I started so late.
sentences.zh: 就我个人而言，因为我开始得太晚了。

sentences.en: I started at 16.
sentences.zh: 我是16岁开始的。

sentences.en: This is just like a personal experience for me.
sentences.zh: 这只是我个人的经历。

sentences.en: But I had like a good system because we had like our producer, Teddy and, you know, people looking up for us and taking care of us.
sentences.zh: 但我有一个很好的系统，因为我们有制作人Teddy，还有照顾我们的人。

sentences.en: So I personally felt like it really helped me quickly pick up on, like, because I had shorter time than all the other girls.
sentences.zh: 所以我个人觉得它确实帮助我快速上手，因为我比其他女孩的时间更短。

sentences.en: And they really, they got me to train in such a short amount of time so I could be as good as the other girls.
sentences.zh: 他们确实让我能在这么短的时间内训练，这样我就能和其他女孩一样优秀。

sentences.en: And that's how I got my career.
sentences.zh: 这就是我获得职业生涯的方式。

sentences.en: And I get to do what I do today.
sentences.zh: 我才能做我现在做的事情。

sentences.en: And so, like, for me, it's been a pretty good experience.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这是一次相当不错的经历。

sentences.en: But it might have been harder if you'd had to do it longer or started younger?
sentences.zh: 但如果你做得更久或者起步更早，情况会不会更艰难？

sentences.en: Oh, I wouldn't know because I haven't.
sentences.zh: 哦，我不知道，因为我没有经历过。

sentences.en: I guess I'm wondering, would you recommend that a teenage girl take the same path that you did?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你会建议十几岁的女孩走和你一样的路吗？

sentences.en: I think if you have the dream and the determination, then go for it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果你有梦想和决心，那就去尝试吧。

sentences.en: It was like exactly what my dad said.
sentences.zh: 这和我爸爸说的一模一样。

sentences.en: I was like, me?
sentences.zh: 我当时想，我吗？

sentences.en: Like, Dad, I have never done like a vocal lesson in my life.
sentences.zh: 我说，爸，我这辈子从来没上过声乐课。

sentences.en: I don't know how to do anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不会。

sentences.en: I don't know, never danced in my life.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，我这辈子从没跳过舞。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I was 16.
sentences.zh: 当时我才16岁。

sentences.en: And so, but he was like, Rosie, if you love it, you try it.
sentences.zh: 但他对我说，Rosie，如果你热爱它，就去尝试。

sentences.en: And if you don't want to regret it in 10 years, you better try it now.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想在十年后后悔，最好现在就去试。

sentences.en: And that was probably the best advice.
sentences.zh: 那大概是我听过最好的建议。

sentences.en: And I went there and I discovered my, you know, my determination.
sentences.zh: 我去了那里，发现了自己的决心。

sentences.en: And, you know, that's what I had.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是我所拥有的。

sentences.en: And I had the drive.
sentences.zh: 我很有干劲。

sentences.en: I remember my parents would be like, Rosie, just like, because it was hard.
sentences.zh: 我记得我父母会说，Rosie，因为那真的很辛苦。

sentences.en: It's not easy at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不容易。

sentences.en: And I'd call crying.
sentences.zh: 我经常哭着给他们打电话。

sentences.en: And they'd be like, come home.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，回家吧。

sentences.en: And that would be the last thing I'd want to hear.
sentences.zh: 而那是我最不想听到的话。

sentences.en: I'd be like, no, going home is not an option.
sentences.zh: 我会说，不，回家不是我的选项。

sentences.en: I'm going to make this happen.
sentences.zh: 我一定要成功。

sentences.en: And we did it.
sentences.zh: 最后我们做到了。

sentences.en: We came out as Blackpink and I'm here today.
sentences.zh: 我们以Blackpink的身份出道，而我今天坐在这里。

sentences.en: So I think it was...
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是……

sentences.en: Great thing.
sentences.zh: 一件伟大的事。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: For me, it was.
sentences.zh: 对我来说是这样。

sentences.en: Do you think it changed who you were, everything that you went through at YG and this whole crazy journey that you've just described?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你在YG经历的一切，以及你刚才描述的这段疯狂旅程，改变了你吗？

sentences.en: Not really.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: I think who I am.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我还是我。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Like, inside.
sentences.zh: 从内心深处来说。

sentences.en: I think if I talk to my mom and my sister and my dad, I feel like this has always been me, like, my personality.
sentences.zh: 我觉得如果我和我妈妈、姐姐还有爸爸谈谈，我会觉得这一直就是我，这就是我的性格。

sentences.en: It was just, I guess, when I went to Korea, that's when it opened up.
sentences.zh: 我想只是当我去了韩国之后，这一切才真正展现出来。

sentences.en: And that's when I started to see, oh, this is me as a person.
sentences.zh: 那时我才开始意识到，哦，这就是作为个人的我。

sentences.en: And maybe it has, maybe it hasn't.
sentences.zh: 也许改变了，也许没有。

sentences.en: But I don't know if that's something I can say.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这是否是我能断言的。

sentences.en: I guess it's something we have to ask the people around me.
sentences.zh: 我想这得问问我身边的人。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know about myself, really.
sentences.zh: 关于我自己，我真的说不准。

sentences.en: I think that's why I asked a lot of my friends about it.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是为什么我经常问朋友们关于这方面的问题。

sentences.en: I was like, what do you think?
sentences.zh: 我会问，你们怎么看？

sentences.en: Was I too nervous?
sentences.zh: 我当时太紧张了吗？

sentences.en: Do you think I was this?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我是这样吗？

sentences.en: Do you think I was that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我是那样吗？

sentences.en: You know, I like to ask around.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我喜欢到处问问。

sentences.en: That's Rosé.
sentences.zh: 以上是Rosé。
